assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Rechargeable battery is swollen, leaking, visibly damaged, or emits an abnormal odor during inspection or functional testing.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e8 (Rechargeable battery) / Certification: UN38.3 / Certification: IEC 62133-2
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; charge/discharge functional check — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Unit does not power on reliably, or the controller or manual override fails during functional testing.
defects.spec_ref: Part p3 (Main PCB assembly) / BOM e2 (Microcontroller, ATmega328P-AU) / BOM e7 (Resistors, capacitors, connectors, and manual override switch) / Electronics block b2 (Controller and user override)
defects.check_method: Power-on and manual-override functional test — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Soil-moisture probe reading does not respond to changes between dry and moist soil or a suitable test medium.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e3 (Capacitive soil-moisture probe module, analog output) / Electronics block b3 (Soil-moisture probe)
defects.check_method: Functional test in dry and moist test media — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Solenoid valve fails to open or close when commanded, or leaks when closed.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m3 (1-inch solenoid irrigation valve) / Electronics block b4 (Valve driver and solenoid valve)
defects.check_method: Command open/close; inspect for leakage — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Top and bottom shells do not mate correctly, or the split-line step exceeds the specified limit.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: Shell mating faces ±0.1 mm / Tolerance: Split-line step ≤ 0.1 mm
defects.check_method: Visual fit check; measure mating faces and split-line step — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Solar power input or battery charging function fails during functional testing.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e1 (Solar panel, 6 V nominal, approximately 5 W) / BOM e9 (Solar battery charge controller) / Electronics block b1 (Solar power input and regulation) / Electronics block b6 (Solar battery charge controller)
defects.check_method: Solar-input and charging functional test — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Visible scratches, scuffs, or sink marks are present on the exterior shell.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection at 50 cm under D65 light — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

defects.description: Exterior shell color or finish visibly differs from the specified warm white matte appearance.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell)
defects.check_method: Visual comparison under D65 light; colorimeter check — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
